crossRefs.note: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths;
I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them…

translations.web: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
translations.bsb: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
translations.kjv: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
translations.asv: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
